correctness.rationale: For every k>=2,n>=3k-2, clipped three gaps determine all nonzero k-mer multiplicities; balanced directed flow at order k-1 identifies boundary strings except when equal. In the equal one-marker boundary case all k one-one-mer profiles occur exactly once, giving a unique k-1-member collision family. Count capped triples: k^3-(k-1)^3 with k-2 collapsed copies; at n=3k-2 remove only all-capped triple. Standalone full enumeration verifies 110 parameter instances, 31,240 sources, both directions of equivalence; tests are corroboration, not all-parameter proof.
